title: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat and sauté onion, carrots, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and smoked paprika; cook until fragrant (1 minute).
Stir in lentils, bay leaf, and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with lemon wedges and crusty bread.
notes: Lentils thicken as they cool. Add more broth when reheating for a looser texture.

title: Citrus Herb Sheet-Pan Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper; roast 15 min.
Whisk remaining oil with lemon zest/juice, Dijon, honey, dill, and parsley.
Add asparagus and salmon to pan, brush with citrus herb glaze, top salmon with orange slices.
Roast 10–12 min more until salmon flakes easily and potatoes are tender.
notes: Swap asparagus for green beans in winter. Leftover glaze doubles as salad dressing.

title: Mango Chia Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar; stir well.
Fold in half the diced mango. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with remaining mango, toasted coconut, and lime zest before serving.
notes: For extra protein add a scoop of vanilla protein powder and an extra splash of milk.
